name: MorbiDrags: Reinas Malditas
overview:
The first season of MorbiDrags: Reinas Malditas, also known as El Génesis, was officially announced on April 3, 2024. Casting opened the same day with a deadline of April 24, 2024.[1]

On October 30, 2024, the first promotional video for the season was released, revealing that the season would premiere in 2025. A few days later, on November 7, 2024, the Meet The Morbids video was released.
